title: Ryndam medevac
description:
JUNEAU, Alaska - A Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak aircrew aboard an HH-65 Dolphin rescue helicopter safely medevaced a 38-year-old Indonesian crewmember off the cruise ship Ryndam 110 miles southeast of Cordova Monday.

The 17th Coast Guard District command center in Juneau received a call from the Ryndam via satellite phone at approximately 6:55 p.m. requesting a medevac for a crewmember reportedly suffering from weakness and loss of consciousness.

U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Kodiak.
